# v0.3.27 — Keep talking while it works

## What's changed

- **Say something else while a reply is running.** A message sent during a reply used to be taken as part of that reply, so for anything else you had to wait. TheOne now looks at what the reply is doing and decides what your message is about. About that reply (an extra condition, a correction, "stop", "faster", a question about its progress): it joins the reply as usual. About something else: that topic starts on it right away, in the background, and is not mixed into the reply. Main chat still reads as one conversation: each answer follows its message in the order you sent them, appearing at once if it is already done or carrying on live if not. At most three topics work at once; anything beyond that waits its turn as before. If a background topic needs a choice or an approval, the window opens in main chat right away and names the topic. Deleting a queued message stops the work started on it.
- **A new topic about one of your projects works in that project's folder.** A new topic used to start in DSH's folder for chats outside any project even when it was about one of your projects. TheOne now recognises which project a new matter belongs to (from the request itself, or from the topics it draws on) and works in that folder, with no question to answer. Anything else goes where it did before. Nothing is added to your projects in DSH's sidebar.
- **TheOne's own questions follow your language.** The few questions TheOne itself may ask (for example when no model is selected) were always in Chinese; they are now in the language your message is in. A picture or file sent on its own gets a topic named in main chat's language.
- **A topic's todo list from background work reaches main chat.** It appears once main chat gets to that work.

TheOne only organises: it adds its own entries and views, and never changes your settings or your own chats.

Validation: automated tests (211) and type checks passed. In a fresh DSH, with a test model that really calls DSH's tools: a message for another topic sent during a ten-second reply was answered in its topic within a second and shown after the reply; a message about the running reply joined it between its steps; a background topic's question opened in main chat during another reply and its answer reached the topic; three topics worked at once and were shown in send order; a new topic for a project ran its commands in that project's folder, and an unrelated one in the default folder; afterwards no TheOne session was attached to any of your workspaces and the archive held only TheOne's own sessions. A set of 35 hand-written cases for messages sent during a reply is in `eval/` for measuring with a real model.

## 中文

- **回答进行中可以说别的事了。** 以前回答进行中发的消息都会被当成这次回答的一部分，想说别的事只能等。现在 TheOne 会看这次回答在做什么，再判断你的消息是关于什么的。关于这次回答（补充条件、纠正、叫停、催一下、问进度）：照常并进这次回答。关于别的事：它的话题马上在后台开始处理，不会混进当前回答。主聊天读起来仍然是一段对话：每个回答按你发送的顺序接在对应的消息后面，已经做完的立刻出现，没做完的接着实时显示。最多三个话题同时干活，再多的照旧排队。后台话题需要你做选择或授权时，窗口会立刻在主聊天里弹出，并写明是哪个话题。删掉排队中的消息，为它开始的工作也会停下。
- **和你某个项目有关的新话题，会在那个项目的文件夹里干活。** 以前新话题即使是你某个项目的事，也会放在 DSH 给「不属于任何项目的聊天」的文件夹里。现在 TheOne 会判断新的事情属于哪个项目（从请求本身，或从它用到的话题），直接在那个文件夹里干活，不用你回答任何问题。其他的照旧。不会往 DSH 侧边栏的项目里加任何东西。
- **TheOne 自己的提问跟随你的语言。** TheOne 自己偶尔会问的几句话（比如还没选模型时）以前总是中文，现在跟你消息的语言一致。单独发一张图片或一个文件时，新话题按主聊天的语言命名。
- **后台工作的待办清单会显示到主聊天。** 主聊天轮到那项工作时出现。

TheOne 只做整理：它只添加自己的入口和视图，不改你的设置，也不改你自己的会话。

已通过自动化测试（211 项）和类型检查。在全新的 DSH 里用一个会真正调用 DSH 工具的测试模型实际确认：在一个 10 秒的回答进行中发给另一个话题的消息，一秒内就在那个话题里得到回答，并显示在这次回答之后；关于当前回答的消息并进了这次回答的步骤之间；后台话题的提问在另一次回答进行中就在主聊天里弹出，答案送回了话题；三个话题同时干活，按发送顺序显示；项目相关的新话题在那个项目的文件夹里执行命令，无关的在默认文件夹里；之后你的工作区里没有任何 TheOne 会话，归档里只有 TheOne 自己的会话。`eval/` 里有 35 个「回答中发消息」的手写用例，可以用真实模型测量。
